mapper.sql: CTRL_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CTRL_TS, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CTRL_TS, CMD_YN, PRED_STALE_YN, PUMP_COMB, PUMP_CMD_YN, PUMP_CMD_STATUS, PUMP_CUR_HZ, PUMP_TGT_HZ, NATIONAL_CMD_YN, NATIONAL_CMD_STATUS, NATIONAL_CUR_OPEN, NATIONAL_TGT_OPEN, LOCAL_CMD_YN, LOCAL_CMD_STATUS, LOCAL_CUR_OPEN, LOCAL_TGT_OPEN, REASON_CODE, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, CTRL_TS, NOW()) AS AGE_SEC
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_CTRL_CMD_RST WHERE CTRL_TS >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{LOOKBACK_MIN} MINUTE) AND ( (PUMP_CMD_YN = 'Y' AND PUMP_CMD_STATUS = 'READY') OR (NATIONAL_CMD_YN = 'Y' AND NATIONAL_CMD_STATUS = 'READY') OR (LOCAL_CMD_YN = 'Y' AND LOCAL_CMD_STATUS = 'READY') ) ORDER BY CTRL_TS ASC, CTRL_ID ASC
SELECT FROM TB_CTRL_CMD_RST WHERE CTRL_ID = #{CTRL_ID} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM TB_CTRL_CMD_RST ORDER BY CTRL_TS DESC, CTRL_ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CTRL_CMD_RST WHERE CTRL_TS > #{CTRL_TS}
AND PUMP_CMD_YN = 'Y' AND LOCAL_CMD_YN = 'Y' AND NATIONAL_CMD_YN = 'Y'
SELECT FROM TB_CTRL_CMD_RST WHERE CTRL_TS >= #{FROM} AND CTRL_TS <= #{TO} AND CMD_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CTRL_TS DESC, CTRL_ID DESC LIMIT 2000

SELECT CTR_IDX, CTR_NM, OPT_IDX, TAG, VALUE, ANLY_CD, FLAG, DATE_FORMAT(RGSTR_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS RGSTR_TIME, DATE_FORMAT(UPDT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS UPDT_TIME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, RGSTR_TIME, NOW()) AS RGSTR_AGE_SEC, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, UPDT_TIME, NOW()) AS UPDT_AGE_SEC FROM TB_HMI_CTR_TAG WHERE OPT_IDX = #{OPT_IDX} ORDER BY CTR_IDX ASC

SELECT CTR_IDX, CTR_NM, OPT_IDX, TAG, VALUE, ANLY_CD, FLAG, DATE_FORMAT(UPDT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS UPDT_TIME FROM TB_HMI_CTR_TAG WHERE OPT_IDX LIKE CONCAT('CTRL:', #{CTRL_ID}, ':%') ORDER BY CTR_IDX ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_HMI_CTR_TAG WHERE FLAG IN ('0', '1') AND (OPT_IDX IS NULL OR OPT_IDX NOT LIKE CONCAT('CTRL:', #{CTRL_ID}, ':%'))
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_HMI_CTR_TAG SET FLAG = '3' WHERE OPT_IDX = #{OPT_IDX} AND FLAG IN ('0', '1')
mapper.select: SELECT PUMP_IDX, PUMP_NM, PMB_TAG, SPI_TAG, CTR_AUTO_FREQ_TAG FROM TB_CTR_PRF_PUMPMST_INF WHERE USE_YN = '1' AND PUMP_GRP = #{PUMP_GRP} ORDER BY PUMP_IDX
SELECT TAGNAME, VALUE, DATE_FORMAT(TS, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS TS FROM TB_RAWDATA WHERE TAGNAME = #{TAG} AND TS >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{FRESH_MIN} MINUTE) ORDER BY TS DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT TAG_DSC, TAG, DEFAULT_VALUE FROM TB_WPP_TAG_CODE WHERE FUNC_TYP = 'CtrlCmdTag'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CTRL_CMD_TRACE (CTRL_ID, DEVICE, ACTION, REASON, TGT_VALUE, USER_ID, DETAIL) VALUES (#{CTRL_ID}, #{DEVICE}, #{ACTION}, #{REASON}, #{TGT_VALUE}, #{USER_ID}, #{DETAIL})
mapper.select: SELECT TRACE_ID, CTRL_ID, DEVICE, ACTION, REASON, TGT_VALUE, USER_ID, DETAIL, DATE_FORMAT(TS, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS TS FROM TB_CTRL_CMD_TRACE WHERE CTRL_ID IN #{id} ORDER BY TRACE_ID ASC
